meta.name: talking-head-recut
meta.description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给视频添加动态图文叠加层，同步字幕与画面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为访谈或播客视频添加专业图文卡片
copy.tagline_en: Add timed graphic overlays to videos, synced with transcript
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add professional graphic cards to interview or podcast videos

howto.what: Claude 会为你的谈话/采访/播客视频添加与语音同步的图形卡片（如动态标题、下三分、数据标注、引用等），视频本身保持不变，最终生成带卡片的 MP4 文件。
howto.when: 当你提到“graphic overlays”、“on-screen graphics”或“package / dress up my video”等关键词时触发。如果不确定，Claude 会引导你使用 /hyperframes。

say.text: 给这个访谈视频加上图形覆盖卡片。
say.note: Claude 会分析转录并设计卡片。

say.text: 帮我包装这段播客，添加下三分和引用。
say.note: Claude 会同步语音时间轴生成卡片。

howto.what_en: Claude will add timed, designed graphic overlay cards (e.g., kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes) to a talking-head/interview/podcast video, synced to the transcript, while keeping the original clip untouched, and render the result as an MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", or ask to "package / dress up my video". If unclear, Claude directs you to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Add graphic overlay cards to this interview video.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes the transcript and designs the cards.

say_en.text: Package this podcast clip with lower-thirds and quotes.
say_en.note: Claude syncs cards to the speech timeline.
